headline: Australia Sets Ride-Hailing Delivery Wage at Rp 395,000 Per Hour, With Accident Insurance
summary: Food and grocery delivery workers in Australia will receive at least 31.30 Australian dollars per hour. The wage standard includes accident insurance.
why: Gig-economy delivery platforms depend on contractor labour, so minimum pay rules affect their operating costs and business models. Australia is a major market for these services.
